provenance.notes: Inventory and names come from the components index page, cross-checked against sitemap.xml — extraction throws if the two disagree or if this config does not cover the inventory exactly. The stylesheet source is fetched over HTTP (hence the live-site kind) but its URL pins the npm release, so daisyui@5.7.22 is byte-stable; the snapshot manifest hashes it either way. Demo documents are markup written in the extractor, not extracted values; each one loads only that pinned stylesheet, and every class it uses is verified to exist in it. The Calendar demo additionally loads the Cally web component (pinned 0.9.2) because daisyUI ships calendar theming, not a calendar.
